specific_limits: The success-path execute() test substitutes validated plan/argv, CLI verification, native source response and cutover.main; it uses only a synthetic token. Other tests exercise real validated() against current accepted artifacts. This is not live credential retrieval plus real cutover integration proof.

The advisory lexists check is not atomic with credential retrieval. A concurrent reservation after that check can still cause an original-token read before the authoritative consumer refuses. The under-lock consumer reservation remains the mutation/replay gate; no bypass or automatic retry is accepted.

entrypoint_handoff_entered is set immediately before common.handoff and can be true on a pipe failure before cutover.main is invoked. Treat it as handoff-attempt progress, not proof of reservation, lifecycle actions or query execution.
